question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**another**" means one more or a different one, suitable for the context of passing from one subject to a different one.
 
• **It connects well with the flow of the sentence indicating an abrupt change in subject.**
 
• The other options: "one other", "an other", and "on other" do not fit the grammatical and contextual requirements.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His speech had begun to falter, and he passed abruptly from one subject to another__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **One other:** Grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• **An other:** Incorrect usage as "another" is the proper compound form.
 
• **On other:** Grammatically incorrect.
